tagline: Hardware-backed spending authorization for AI agents on NEAR
description: Tapproved enables autonomous AI agents to request payments from a NEAR smart contract treasury under strict policy limits. Routine payments execute automatically within configurable soft limits, while high-value payments strictly require physical human approval via an Ed25519-signing ESP32 hardware device.
features: Dual-tier spending policies (soft limit, hard limit, daily quota)
Idempotent guarded state migration on live Testnet
Promise-based transfer settlement with automatic reservation accounting
Official AI Agent JavaScript/TypeScript SDK with typed errors
Autonomous demo agent with automatic policy violation handling
Real-time dark-mode treasury monitoring dashboard and NEAR CLI command generator
